name: Toratani Rikka
source:
Year: 1st Year
Favorite Subject: Doesn’t have any. Weak in all subjects.
Favorite Thing: Hooded parka
Favorite Food: Cherries
Things that he isn’t good at: General Exercise
Favorite Words: A perfect lie exceeds even the truth.

A mischievous boy with a cute and delicate atmosphere. However, thanks to his appearance he is forgiven mostly for his carefree smile and personality. Though he loves to make fun of people and play pranks on them, he himself is not good with being made fun of. He blushes when he hears romance stories and quickly shows a shy face.
